The Partisans' clips are reworked so they move with weight and die more naturally. In `idle` he shifts his weight from foot to foot, his feet planted, and in `move` his feet lift higher. In `fight` he steps into the throw, lifting his foot clear, and the molotov leaves his hand as it's moving fastest. In `die` (now 1.5 s) a shot snaps him back, his knees give, his left foot slides out and kicks up while his right stays where he stood, and he lands on his back, his head and arms after him, his right leg flopping out straight and his left knee falling last.
